basic_info.description: Just two blocks from Ocean Beach, this move-in ready Outer Sunset home offers fresh updates and a spacious east-facing backyard, ready for the new owner to make it their own. Recent improvements include new quartz counters, new appliances, refinished floors and new paint inside and outside, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere. The main level features a warm and inviting living room, two well proportioned bedrooms, one bathroom, a kitchen and dining area. Skylights in both the kitchen and bathroom fill the home with natural light. Downstairs, a sizable bonus room, mudroom with laundry hookups, and an attached garage with interior access provide flexibility and excellent storage options. The expansive backyard offers endless possibilities for gardening, outdoor dining, or creating a private retreat. Park one car in the garage and another in the driveway. Enjoy a laid-back beachside lifestyle just moments from vibrant shops and restaurants on Noriega Street and Irving Street corridor, as well as the iconic Golden Gate Park.
